textures.name: sea
textures.prompt:
Aerial photograph taken straight down from very high above of calm deep
open sea, an even deep blue with a very fine, faint, uniform texture of
tiny ripples, low contrast, no foam, no glare, no sun reflection,
nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: land
textures.prompt:
Satellite photograph taken straight down from very high above of a vast
tropical rainforest, the canopy seen as a fine, even, uniform texture of
countless tiny green tree crowns, low contrast, no clearings, no rivers,
nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: sand
textures.prompt:
Aerial photograph taken straight down of pale golden beach sand, fine,
even and uniform, low contrast, nothing else, filling the whole image.

textures.name: town
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single small 17th-century
Caribbean colonial house with white plastered walls, a red clay tile
roof, a dark door and two small windows, standing alone on a plain flat
light grey ground, nothing else.
